description_short: Geology & Reservoir Engineering is a mod that adds geothermal energy, underground water/gas injection, and enhanced oil recovery to Captain of Industry.
description_long:
Geology & Reservoir Engineering adds subsurface resource extraction and injection systems built around three dedicated pumps.

A water injection pump recharges geothermal reservoirs (three enthalpy tiers) and the vanilla groundwater aquifer. An oil injection pump offers enhanced oil recovery, hydraulic fracturing, and thermal EOR (steam injection) directly on the vanilla crude oil deposit. A new Natural Gas deposit - extracted by its own well, co-located with existing crude oil as associated gas - can be treated into vanilla Fuel Gas or stored underground via a third dedicated injection pump.

Designed as a foundation other mods can build on: prototype IDs are exposed publicly, and every deposit type is freely placeable in the map editor. Raw Natural Gas can also be burned directly in a vanilla Flare or gas-fired Boiler, without first being treated into Fuel Gas. A Natural Gas Rig is also available on the World Map/exploration map, using the same core game API as the vanilla Oil Rig - WorldGen++ is fully optional and not required. Fixed a balance issue where recharge could stack uncapped across multiple pumps targeting the same deposit; recharge is now capped once per deposit per check. A fifth oil injection pump recipe (acid stimulation) and a second natural gas injection pump recipe (thermal enhanced gas recovery, distinct from underground storage) have been added; the reserve status panel now aggregates across every recognized resource a pump can see. Fixed a bug where an injection pump could recharge a deposit type it wasn't restricted to (e.g. the natural gas pump recharging a co-located crude oil deposit); the standalone Thermal enhanced gas recovery research node has been merged into Natural gas extraction. Groundwater now recharges at its own, noticeably slower rate than geothermal reservoirs, rather than sharing the same fast pace.
